source: UCL measurement diamonds only, EA SC120002/R Figures 4.25 and 4.26
citation: Neelz and Pender (2013), SC120002/R, Figures 4.25-4.26; underlying IMPACT/UCL experiment cited therein

quantity_definitions.level_m: Water surface elevation in metres above the flat flume bed
quantity_definitions.speed_mps: Scalar velocity magnitude in metres per second as labelled in Figure 4.26

datum: Flat flume bed = 0 m, per UK specification

uncertainty.digitization: Conservative +/-1 pixel per axis; per-series physical conversion in digitization-audit.json
uncertainty.time_binning: Markers in the same x-pixel column are averaged; min/max and counts retained

coverage: Audit-only, more restrictive visibility-selected subset. Does not replace historical reference or represent the complete experiment.
selection_limitations: Occluded/overlapping markers are omitted. This is a visibility-selected subset and does not estimate fit to the complete experiment.
extraction: Independent eight-neighbor connected components; exactly 13 pixels, 5×5 support, integer center and Manhattan radius two; same chart bounds and legend exclusion.
peer_review_status: Independent algorithm and visual review by the same assistant, not a second-person review.
